name: Hey_1
short_caption: The robot waves its right hand high in a friendly greeting.
movement_description: The robot starts in a neutral posture and raises its right arm high, opening its hand to wave. It waves the right hand side-to-side twice with a slight head tilt toward the hand. Finally, the robot lowers its arm back down and returns its head to a centered, neutral position.
safety_notes: The right arm extends upwards and slightly outwards, requiring clear vertical and right-side clearance.
